declarations.type:
∀ {I O : Type} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype O] (T : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.TailFamily I O) (m : ℕ)
  (B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases) (w : (i : I) → ℤ → ℕ → ℕ → Fin (T.dim i) → ℂ) (o : O) (n : ℤ)

  (∀ (i : I) (c : Fin (T.dim i)), IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => T.mult i o c p θ) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi)) →
    T.outputMode m B w o n p =
      ∑ i,
        ∑ c,
          ∑ n' ∈ T.inModes,
            (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (T.inputDeg i + 1),
                ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (T.inputDeg i + 1), w i n' j l c * ↑(B.radialPoly j p.1 * B.heightPoly l p.2)) *
              (1 / (2 * ↑Real.pi) *
                ∫ (θ : ℝ) in 0..2 * Real.pi,
                  Complex.exp (-↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.azimuth m (n - n') * θ) * Complex.I) *
                    T.mult i o c p θ)

declarations.type:
∀ {k N : ℕ} (c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N) (K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox)
  (S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars) (B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases),
  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBases K B →
    ∀ (F : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.FarMajorantData) (x : Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.FieldTuple k)
      (ζ : Fin k → ℝ) (n : ℤ) (a b : Fin 3) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
      (∀ (i : Fin 2) (o : Fin 3 × Fin 3)
          (c' : Fin ((Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.strainGroupFamily c K S F).dim i)),
          IntervalIntegrable
            (fun θ => (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.strainGroupFamily c K S F).mult i o c' p θ)
            MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi)) →
        (∀ (x y : Fin 3),
            IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.strainAt c p θ x y)
                MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) ∧
              IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.curlGradAt c p θ x y)
                MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi)) →
          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.strainGroupFamily c K S F).outputMode c.order B
              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.strainInput
                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.farVector c K S B x ζ))
              (a, b) n p =

                Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.waveActionStrain
                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.strainMode c (n - n') p)
                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.curlGradMode c (n - n') p)
                  (K.lowStrainAt c.order n' S.degHigh x.2.1 p) (K.lowVelocityAt c.order n' S.degHigh x.1 p) a b

declarations.type:
∀ {f : ℝ → ℂ} {K : NNReal},
  LipschitzWith K f →
    ∀ {x : ℝ} {f' : ℂ},
      HasDerivAt f f' x →
        ∀ {u v : ℕ → ℝ},
          (∀ (N : ℕ), u N < x) →
            (∀ (N : ℕ), x < v N) →
              Filter.Tendsto (fun N => v N - u N) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
                ∀ (α β : ℂ),
                  Filter.Tendsto
                    (fun N =>
                      β * (↑((v N - x) / (v N - u N)) * f (u N) + ↑((x - u N) / (v N - u N)) * f (v N)) +
                        α * (↑(1 / (v N - u N)) * (f (v N) - f (u N))))

declarations.name: Breakdown.FracInternal.LayoutRowVolume.volume_pointwise
declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N : ℕ} (c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N) (K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox)
  (S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars) (x : Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.FieldTuple k),
  (∀ (n : ℤ), n ∈ S.resolved ↔ -n ∈ S.resolved) →
    ∀ {p : ℝ × ℝ},
      0 < p.1 →
        0 ≤ p.2 →
          (∀ (n : ℤ) (a b : Fin 3),
              K.lowStrain c.order (-n) S.degHigh x.2.1 a b p =
                (starRingEnd ℂ) (K.lowStrain c.order n S.degHigh x.2.1 a b p)) →
            (∀ (n : ℤ) (a : Fin 3),
                K.lowVelocity c.order (-n) S.degHigh x.1 a p =
                  (starRingEnd ℂ) (K.lowVelocity c.order n S.degHigh x.1 a p)) →
              (∀ (b : Fin 3),
                  IntervalIntegrable
                    (fun θ =>
                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.frameVec θ
                        (Breakdown.SteadyCert.driftField α c.modelRate x.1 x.2.1
                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2))
                        b)
                    MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi)) →
                (∀ (b : Fin 3),
                    IntervalIntegrable
                      (fun θ =>
                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.frameVec θ
                          (c.modelVelocity (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2)) b)
                      MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi)) →
                  (∀ (b : Fin 3),
                      IntervalIntegrable
                        (fun θ =>
                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.frameVec θ
                            (c.modelCurl (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2)) b)
                        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi)) →
                    (∀ (b : Fin 3),
                        IntervalIntegrable
                          (fun θ =>
                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.frameVec θ
                              (x.1 (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2)) b)
                          MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi)) →
                      (∀ (a b : Fin 3),
                          IntervalIntegrable
                            (fun θ =>
                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.frameMat θ
                                (x.2.1 (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2)) a b)
                            MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi)) →
                        ∀ (ν : ℝ) (m : ℤ) (X : Fin 3 → ℂ) (Y : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ),
                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.pairC
                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec c.order m
                                  (Breakdown.FracInternal.LayoutRowParts.lowTransport c K S α x) p.1 p.2)
                                X +
                              ↑ν *
                                ∑ a,
                                  ∑ b,
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.gradMode c.order m x.2.1 a b p *
                                      (starRingEnd ℂ) (Y a b) =
                            ∑ a,
                                  ∑ b,
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.gradMode c.order m x.2.1 a b p *
                                      (↑(1 / (2 * α)) * Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.frameY p b *
                                            (starRingEnd ℂ) (X a) +
                                          ↑c.modelRate * Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.frameTurnY p b *
                                            (starRingEnd ℂ) (X a) +
                                        ↑ν * (starRingEnd ℂ) (Y a b)) +
                                ∑ a,
                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec c.order m x.1 p.1 p.2 a *
                                    (↑(1 - 1 / (2 * α)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (X a) -
                                      ↑c.modelRate *
                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.pairC
                                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.turnC (Pi.single a 1)) X) +
                              ∑ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                (∑ a',
                                    ∑ b',
                                      K.lowStrain c.order n S.degHigh x.2.1 a' b' p *
                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.pairC
                                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.crossC
                                            (fun i => ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.permSign i b' a'))
                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec c.order (m - n) c.modelVelocity p.1
                                              p.2))
                                          X +
                                  ∑ a',
                                    K.lowVelocity c.order n S.degHigh x.1 a' p *
                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.pairC
                                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.crossC
                                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec c.order (m - n) c.modelCurl p.1 p.2)
                                          (Pi.single a' 1))
                                        X)

declarations.name: Breakdown.FracInternal.LayoutRowPressure.pressure_identity_of_modes
declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N slots : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}
  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases}
  {Cl : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellClasses} {R : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellRows N slots k}
  {L : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.CellLayout} {x : Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.FieldTuple k} {a : Fin N},
  1 < α →
    α < 5 / 4 →
      Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsFormData α c →
        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellData α c K S B Cl R →
          Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsRowShape c K S R →
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsPressureLayout c K S B L →
              Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsAdmissible c x →
                a ∈ R.rowSet →
                  (∀ a ∈ R.rowSet,
                      ∀ (s : Fin L.presCount) (n : ℤ),
                        ∃ P,
                          (∃ cf, ∀ (t : ℝ), P t = ∑ d, cf d * ↑((L.presSegment s).test (↑d) t)) ∧
                            ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                              ((L.presSegment s).radial = true →
                                  p.1 = (L.presSegment s).level →
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p 0 = P p.2) ∧
                                (¬(L.presSegment s).radial = true →
                                  p.2 = (L.presSegment s).level →
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p 2 = P p.1)) →
                    Breakdown.SteadyCert.l2Pair x.2.2.2.2 (c.row a) / (4 * Real.pi) =
                      (Breakdown.FracInternal.LayoutRowParts.presSideSum c L a x).re

declarations.name: Breakdown.FracInternal.LayoutRowVolume.viscous_mode_identity
declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N slots : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}
  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases}
  {Cl : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellClasses} {R : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellRows N slots k}
  {L : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.CellLayout} {x : Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.FieldTuple k} {a : Fin N},
  1 < α →
    α < 5 / 4 →
      Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsFormData α c →
        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellData α c K S B Cl R →
          Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsRowShape c K S R →
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsPressureLayout c K S B L →
              Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsAdmissible c x →
                a ∈ R.rowSet →
                  (∀ a ∈ R.rowSet,
                      ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (n : ℤ) (i : Fin 3),
                        ∃ P,
                          (∃ cf, ∀ (t : ℝ), P t = ∑ d, cf d * ↑((L.segment s).test (↑d) t)) ∧
                            ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                              ((L.segment s).radial = true →
                                  p.1 = (L.segment s).level →
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p i = P p.2) ∧
                                (¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                                  p.2 = (L.segment s).level →
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p i = P p.1)) →
                    -(c.splitVisc *
                          ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in K.rect,
                            p.1 *
                              (∑ n ∈ R.rowModes,
                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.pairC
                                    (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec c.order n
                                      (fun y => Breakdown.SteadyCert.secondTrace (x.2.2.1 y)) p.1 p.2)
                                    (Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p)).re) =
                      (c.splitVisc *
                          ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in K.rect,
                            p.1 *
                              (∑ n ∈ R.rowModes,
                                  ∑ a',
                                    ∑ b',
                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.gradMode c.order n x.2.1 a' b' p *
                                        (starRingEnd ℂ)
                                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeGrad c a n p a' b')).re) +
                        (Breakdown.FracInternal.LayoutRowParts.gradSideSum c L a x).re

declarations.type:
∀ (weighted : Bool) (F dFr dFz : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ) {rad : Bool} {lev : ℝ},
  (rad = true → Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsRadialWeakPair F dFr) →
    (rad = false → Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsHeightWeakPair (fun r => if weighted = true then r else 1) F dFz) →
      (rad = true → 0 < lev) →
        ∀ {lo mid hi : ℝ},
          lo < mid →
            mid < hi →
              ∀ {t : ℝ → ℝ},
                Continuous t →
                  ∀ (l : List (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.SkeletonKey × ℝ))
                    (G : ℝ → ℝ → Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.SkeletonKey × ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
                    (V : Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.SkeletonKey → ℂ),
                    (∀ p ∈ l,
                        ∃ lo' hi' f,
                          (lo' = lo ∧ hi' = mid ∨ lo' = mid ∧ hi' = hi) ∧
                            Continuous f ∧
                              V p.1 =
                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.MeshSkeletonSplitInternal.momJ weighted F dFr dFz
                                    rad lev lo' hi' f ∧
                                ∀ (a b s : ℝ), G a b p s = if lo' = a ∧ hi' = b then p.2 * f s else 0) →
                      (∀ (lo' hi' : ℝ),
                          lo' = lo ∧ hi' = mid ∨ lo' = mid ∧ hi' = hi →
                            ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc lo' hi', t s = (List.map (fun p => G lo' hi' p s) l).sum) →
                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.MeshSkeletonSplitInternal.momJ weighted F dFr dFz rad lev lo
                            hi t =
                          (List.map (fun p => ↑p.2 * V p.1) l).sum

declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N slots : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}
  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases}

  1 < α →
    α < 5 / 4 →
      Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsFormData α c →
        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellData α c K S B Cl R →
          Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsRowShape c K S R →
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsPressureLayout c K S B L →
              Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsAdmissible c x →
                a ∈ R.rowSet →
                  ∀ (n : ℤ) (i : Fin 3) (cf : Fin L.segCount → Fin (L.degSide + 1) → ℂ),
                    (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                        ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                          ((L.segment s).radial = true →
                              p.1 = (L.segment s).level →
                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p i =
                                  ∑ d, cf s d * ↑((L.segment s).test (↑d) p.2)) ∧
                            (¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                              p.2 = (L.segment s).level →
                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p i =
                                  ∑ d, cf s d * ↑((L.segment s).test (↑d) p.1))) →
                      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
                          (fun p =>
                            ↑p.1 * L.secondModeOf n x i 2 2 p *
                                (starRingEnd ℂ) (Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p i) +
                              L.gradModeOf n x i 2 p *
                                (starRingEnd ℂ)
                                  (↑p.1 *
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox.heightDeriv
                                      (fun q => Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n q i) p))
                          K.rect MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                        ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in K.rect,
                            ↑p.1 * L.secondModeOf n x i 2 2 p *
                                (starRingEnd ℂ) (Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p i) +
                              L.gradModeOf n x i 2 p *
                                (starRingEnd ℂ)
                                  (↑p.1 *
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox.heightDeriv
                                      (fun q => Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n q i) p) =
                          ∑ s,
                            ∑ d,
                              if (L.segment s).radial = true then 0
                              else
                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.edgeSign (L.segment s).level (L.segment s).other *
                                    (starRingEnd ℂ) (cf s d) *
                                  (L.segment s).moment true (L.gradModeOf n x i 2) (L.secondModeOf n x i 2 0)
                                    (L.secondModeOf n x i 2 2) ↑d

declarations.type:
∀ {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}
  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases} {slots : ℕ}

  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsTailBounds K B S.degNear
      (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.strainGroupFamily c K S F) →
    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsTailBounds K B S.degNear
        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.velocityGroupFamily c K S F) →
      (S.band ≠ ∅ →
          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsTailBounds K B S.degNear
            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.bandGroupFamily c K S F)) →
        0 < F.share →
          0 ≤ F.turnBound →
            (∀ n ∈ S.band,
                ∀ (w : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.vecSq
                      (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.turnAdjInv (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.azimuth c.order n)
                        w) ≤
                    F.turnBound ^ 2 * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.vecSq w) →
              0 < F.strainFloor ∧ 0 < F.velocityFloor →
                (∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                    S.degNear < max j l →
                      (n ∈ S.resolved ∪ S.band →
                          F.strainFloor ≤ S.symWeight n j l ∧ F.strainFloor ≤ S.antiWeight n j l) ∧
                        (n ∈ S.resolved → F.velocityFloor ≤ S.velWeight n j l)) →
                  (if S.band = ∅ then 1 else 1 + F.share) / F.strainFloor ≤ F.strainWeight →
                    1 / F.velocityFloor ≤ F.resolvedVelocityWeight →
                      (S.band ≠ ∅ → (1 + 1 / F.share) * F.turnBound ^ 2 / F.strainFloor ≤ F.bandVelocityWeight) →
                        (∀ n ∈ S.resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, S.localMatrix n p = S.localMatrix n (K.r₁, K.z₁)) →
                          (∀ (i : Fin k),
                              ∀ n ∈ R.yModes,
                                ∀ (a b : Fin 3),
                                  ∃ P ∈ Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.polyFn S.degNear S.degNear,
                                    ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo K.r₁ K.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo K.z₁ K.z₂,
                                      p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                        ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p) *
                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order n (c.modelActuatorGrad i)
                                              p.1 p.2 a b =
                                          P p) →
                            (∀ (i : Fin k),
                                ∀ n ∈ R.yModes,
                                  ∀ (a b : Fin 3),
                                    ∃ P ∈ Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.polyFn S.degNear S.degNear,
                                      ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo K.r₁ K.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo K.z₁ K.z₂,
                                        p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                          ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p) *
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order n (c.modelPinField i) p.1
                                                p.2 a b =
                                            P p) →
                              (∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                  ∀ (a : Fin 3) (comp : Fin 4) (j l : ℕ),
                                    j ≤ S.degHigh → l ≤ S.degHigh → (n, a, comp, j, l) ∈ R.farSupport) →
                                (∀ (u : ℤ × Fin 3 × Fin 4 × ℕ × ℕ ⊕ Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℂ),
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.farMajorantForm c K S F u ≤
                                      (∑ i ∈ R.farSupport.disjSum Finset.univ,
                                          ∑ i' ∈ R.farSupport.disjSum Finset.univ,

              0 < F.strainFloor ∧ 0 < F.velocityFloor →
                (∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                    S.degNear < max j l →
                      (n ∈ S.resolved ∪ S.band →
                          F.strainFloor ≤ S.symWeight n j l ∧ F.strainFloor ≤ S.antiWeight n j l) ∧
                        (n ∈ S.resolved → F.velocityFloor ≤ S.velWeight n j l)) →
                  (if S.band = ∅ then 1 else 1 + F.share) / F.strainFloor ≤ F.strainWeight →
                    1 / F.velocityFloor ≤ F.resolvedVelocityWeight →
                      (S.band ≠ ∅ → (1 + 1 / F.share) * F.turnBound ^ 2 / F.strainFloor ≤ F.bandVelocityWeight) →
                        (∀ n ∈ S.resolved, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, S.localMatrix n p = S.localMatrix n (K.r₁, K.z₁)) →
                          (∀ (i : Fin k),
                              ∀ n ∈ R.yModes,

                                  ∃ P ∈ Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.polyFn S.degNear S.degNear,

                                      ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo K.r₁ K.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo K.z₁ K.z₂,
                                        p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                          ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p) *
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order n (c.modelPinField i) p.1
                                                p.2 a b =

                              (∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                  ∀ (a : Fin 3) (comp : Fin 4) (j l : ℕ),
                                    j ≤ S.degHigh → l ≤ S.degHigh → (n, a, comp, j, l) ∈ R.farSupport) →
                                (∀ (u : ℤ × Fin 3 × Fin 4 × ℕ × ℕ ⊕ Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℂ),

  {Cl : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellClasses} {R : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellRows N slots k}
  {L : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.CellLayout} {x : Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.FieldTuple k} {a : Fin N},
  1 < α →
    α < 5 / 4 →
      Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsFormData α c →
        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellData α c K S B Cl R →
          Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsRowShape c K S R →
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsPressureLayout c K S B L →
              Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsAdmissible c x →
                a ∈ R.rowSet →
                  (∀ a ∈ R.rowSet,
                      ∀ (s : Fin L.presCount) (n : ℤ),
                        ∃ P,
                          (∃ cf, ∀ (t : ℝ), P t = ∑ d, cf d * ↑((L.presSegment s).test (↑d) t)) ∧
                            ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                              ((L.presSegment s).radial = true →
                                  p.1 = (L.presSegment s).level →
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p 0 = P p.2) ∧

                          ↑p.1 *
                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.pairC
                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec c.order n x.2.2.2.2 p.1 p.2)
                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p) =
                        ∑ s,
                          ∑ d,
                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.presSideRowCoef c L a n s ↑d *

                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.bandGroupFamily c K S F)) →
                          (share_pos : 0 < F.share) →
                            (turnBound_nonneg : 0 ≤ F.turnBound) →

                                  (far_floor :

                                        S.degNear < max j l →
                                          (n ∈ S.resolved ∪ S.band →
                                              F.strainFloor ≤ S.symWeight n j l ∧ F.strainFloor ≤ S.antiWeight n j l) ∧
                                            (n ∈ S.resolved → F.velocityFloor ≤ S.velWeight n j l)) →
                                    (strainWeight_ge :
                                        (if S.band = ∅ then 1 else 1 + F.share) / F.strainFloor ≤ F.strainWeight) →
                                      (resolvedVelocityWeight_ge : 1 / F.velocityFloor ≤ F.resolvedVelocityWeight) →
                                        (bandVelocityWeight_ge :
                                            S.band ≠ ∅ →
                                              (1 + 1 / F.share) * F.turnBound ^ 2 / F.strainFloor ≤
                                                F.bandVelocityWeight) →
                                          (localMatrix_const :
                                              ∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                                ∀ p ∈ K.rect, S.localMatrix n p = S.localMatrix n (K.r₁, K.z₁)) →
                                            (actuator_poly :
                                                ∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                  ∀ n ∈ R.yModes,
                                                    ∀ (a b : Fin 3),
                                                      ∃ P ∈ Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.polyFn S.degNear S.degNear,

                                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order n
                                                                  (c.modelActuatorGrad i) p.1 p.2 a b =
                                                              P p) →
                                              (pin_poly :
                                                  ∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                    ∀ n ∈ R.yModes,
                                                      ∀ (a b : Fin 3),
                                                        ∃
                                                          P ∈
                                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.polyFn S.degNear S.degNear,
                                                          ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo K.r₁ K.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo K.z₁ K.z₂,

                                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order n
                                                                    (c.modelPinField i) p.1 p.2 a b =
                                                                P p) →
                                                (support_contains :
                                                    ∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                                      ∀ (a : Fin 3) (comp : Fin 4) (j l : ℕ),

                    ((strain_bounds :

                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.strainGroupFamily c K S F)) →
                        (velocity_bounds :
                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsTailBounds K B S.degNear
                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.velocityGroupFamily c K S F)) →
                          (band_bounds :
                              S.band ≠ ∅ →
                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsTailBounds K B S.degNear
                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.bandGroupFamily c K S F)) →
                            (share_pos : 0 < F.share) →
                              (turnBound_nonneg : 0 ≤ F.turnBound) →
                                (turn_bound :
                                    ∀ n ∈ S.band,
                                      ∀ (w : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.vecSq
                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.turnAdjInv
                                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.azimuth c.order n) w) ≤
                                          F.turnBound ^ 2 * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.vecSq w) →
                                  (floors_pos : 0 < F.strainFloor ∧ 0 < F.velocityFloor) →
                                    (far_floor :
                                        ∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                          S.degNear < max j l →
                                            (n ∈ S.resolved ∪ S.band →
                                                F.strainFloor ≤ S.symWeight n j l ∧
                                                  F.strainFloor ≤ S.antiWeight n j l) ∧
                                              (n ∈ S.resolved → F.velocityFloor ≤ S.velWeight n j l)) →
                                      (strainWeight_ge :
                                          (if S.band = ∅ then 1 else 1 + F.share) / F.strainFloor ≤ F.strainWeight) →
                                        (resolvedVelocityWeight_ge : 1 / F.velocityFloor ≤ F.resolvedVelocityWeight) →
                                          (bandVelocityWeight_ge :
                                              S.band ≠ ∅ →
                                                (1 + 1 / F.share) * F.turnBound ^ 2 / F.strainFloor ≤
                                                  F.bandVelocityWeight) →
                                            (localMatrix_const :
                                                ∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                                  ∀ p ∈ K.rect, S.localMatrix n p = S.localMatrix n (K.r₁, K.z₁)) →
                                              (actuator_poly :
                                                  ∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                    ∀ n ∈ R.yModes,
                                                      ∀ (a b : Fin 3),
                                                        ∃
                                                          P ∈
                                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.polyFn S.degNear S.degNear,
                                                          ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo K.r₁ K.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo K.z₁ K.z₂,
                                                            p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                                              ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p) *
                                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order n
                                                                    (c.modelActuatorGrad i) p.1 p.2 a b =
                                                                P p) →
                                                (pin_poly :
                                                    ∀ (i : Fin k),
                                                      ∀ n ∈ R.yModes,
                                                        ∀ (a b : Fin 3),
                                                          ∃
                                                            P ∈
                                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.polyFn S.degNear
                                                                S.degNear,
                                                            ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo K.r₁ K.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo K.z₁ K.z₂,
                                                              p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                                                ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K
                                                                        p) *
                                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order n
                                                                      (c.modelPinField i) p.1 p.2 a b =
                                                                  P p) →
                                                  (support_contains :
                                                      ∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                                        ∀ (a : Fin 3) (comp : Fin 4) (j l : ℕ),
                                                          j ≤ S.degHigh →
                                                            l ≤ S.degHigh → (n, a, comp, j, l) ∈ R.farSupport) →
                                                    (kernel_dominates :
                                                        ∀ (u : ℤ × Fin 3 × Fin 4 × ℕ × ℕ ⊕ Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℂ),
                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.farMajorantForm c
                                                              K S F u ≤

∀ {α : ℝ} {k N slots : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}
  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases}
  {Cl : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellClasses} {R : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellRows N slots k}
  {L : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.CellLayout} {x : Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.FieldTuple k} {a : Fin N},
  1 < α →
    α < 5 / 4 →
      Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsFormData α c →
        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellData α c K S B Cl R →
          Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsRowShape c K S R →
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsPressureLayout c K S B L →
              Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsAdmissible c x →
                a ∈ R.rowSet →
                  ∀ (n : ℤ) (cf : Fin L.presCount → Fin L.degSide → ℂ),
                    (∀ (s : Fin L.presCount),
                        ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                          ((L.presSegment s).radial = true →
                              p.1 = (L.presSegment s).level →
                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p 0 =
                                  ∑ d, cf s d * ↑((L.presSegment s).test (↑d) p.2)) ∧
                            (¬(L.presSegment s).radial = true →
                              p.2 = (L.presSegment s).level →
                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p 2 =
                                  ∑ d, cf s d * ↑((L.presSegment s).test (↑d) p.1))) →
                      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
                          (fun p =>
                            ↑p.1 * L.pressureGradMode n x 2 p *
                                (starRingEnd ℂ) (Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p 2) +
                              L.pressMode n x p *
                                (starRingEnd ℂ)
                                  (↑p.1 *
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox.heightDeriv
                                      (fun q => Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n q 2) p))
                          K.rect MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                        ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in K.rect,
                            ↑p.1 * L.pressureGradMode n x 2 p *
                                (starRingEnd ℂ) (Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p 2) +
                              L.pressMode n x p *
                                (starRingEnd ℂ)
                                  (↑p.1 *
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox.heightDeriv
                                      (fun q => Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n q 2) p) =
                          ∑ s,
                            ∑ d,
                              if (L.presSegment s).radial = true then 0
                              else
                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.edgeSign (L.presSegment s).level
                                      (L.presSegment s).other *
                                    (starRingEnd ℂ) (cf s d) *
                                  (L.presSegment s).moment true (L.pressMode n x) (L.pressureGradMode n x 0)
                                    (L.pressureGradMode n x 2) ↑d

declarations.type:

  Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment S →
    (S.radial = true → S.level ≠ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ min S.level S.other) →
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (Q Q' : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
        Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsGradientField Q →
          Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsGradientField Q' →
            ∀ (a b C e e' e'' : ℝ),
              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.potentialOf (a • Q + b • Q') =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] fun y =>
                  a * Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.potentialOf Q y +
                      b * Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.potentialOf Q' y +
                    C) →
                ∀ (d : ℕ),
                  S.moment true
                      (fun p =>
                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.presMode m 0
                          (fun y => Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.potentialOf (a • Q + b • Q') y - e'') p.1 p.2)
                      (fun p => Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec m 0 (a • Q + b • Q') p.1 p.2 0)
                      (fun p => Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec m 0 (a • Q + b • Q') p.1 p.2 2) d =
                    ↑a *
                          S.moment true
                            (fun p =>
                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.presMode m 0
                                (fun y => Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.potentialOf Q y - e) p.1 p.2)
                            (fun p => Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec m 0 Q p.1 p.2 0)
                            (fun p => Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec m 0 Q p.1 p.2 2) d +
                        ↑b *
                          S.moment true
                            (fun p =>
                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.presMode m 0
                                (fun y => Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.potentialOf Q' y - e') p.1 p.2)
                            (fun p => Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec m 0 Q' p.1 p.2 0)
                            (fun p => Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec m 0 Q' p.1 p.2 2) d +
                      ↑(C - e'' + a * e + b * e') * S.moment true (fun x => 1) (fun x => 0) (fun x => 0) d

declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N slots : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}

            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsPressureLayout c K S B L →

                a ∈ R.rowSet →

                        ∃ P,
                          (∃ cf, ∀ (t : ℝ), P t = ∑ d, cf d * ↑((L.segment s).test (↑d) t)) ∧
                            ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                              ((L.segment s).radial = true →
                                  p.1 = (L.segment s).level →
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p i = P p.2) ∧
                                (¬(L.segment s).radial = true →

                                  (fun y => Breakdown.SteadyCert.secondTrace (x.2.2.1 y)) p.1 p.2)
                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p))
                          K.rect MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
                            (fun p =>
                              ↑p.1 *
                                ∑ a',
                                  ∑ b',
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.gradMode c.order n x.2.1 a' b' p *
                                      (starRingEnd ℂ) (Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeGrad c a n p a' b'))
                            K.rect MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                          -(↑c.splitVisc *
                                ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in K.rect,

                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.pairC
                                      (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec c.order n

                                          (L.secondModeOf n x a' 0 2) ↑d

declarations.name: Breakdown.FracInternal.LayoutRowPressureBoundaryParts.radial_side_pairing
declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N slots : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}
  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases}
  {Cl : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellClasses} {R : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellRows N slots k}
  {L : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.CellLayout} {x : Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.FieldTuple k} {a : Fin N},
  1 < α →
    α < 5 / 4 →
      Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsFormData α c →
        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellData α c K S B Cl R →
          Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsRowShape c K S R →
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsPressureLayout c K S B L →
              Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsAdmissible c x →
                a ∈ R.rowSet →
                  ∀ (n : ℤ) (cf : Fin L.presCount → Fin L.degSide → ℂ),
                    (∀ (s : Fin L.presCount),
                        ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                          ((L.presSegment s).radial = true →
                              p.1 = (L.presSegment s).level →
                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p 0 =
                                  ∑ d, cf s d * ↑((L.presSegment s).test (↑d) p.2)) ∧
                            (¬(L.presSegment s).radial = true →
                              p.2 = (L.presSegment s).level →
                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p 2 =
                                  ∑ d, cf s d * ↑((L.presSegment s).test (↑d) p.1))) →
                      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
                          (fun p =>
                            ↑p.1 * L.pressureGradMode n x 0 p *
                                (starRingEnd ℂ) (Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p 0) +
                              L.pressMode n x p *
                                (starRingEnd ℂ)
                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox.radialDeriv
                                    (fun q => ↑q.1 * Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n q 0) p))
                          K.rect MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                        ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in K.rect,
                            ↑p.1 * L.pressureGradMode n x 0 p *
                                (starRingEnd ℂ) (Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p 0) +
                              L.pressMode n x p *
                                (starRingEnd ℂ)
                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox.radialDeriv
                                    (fun q => ↑q.1 * Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n q 0) p) =
                          ∑ s,
                            ∑ d,
                              if (L.presSegment s).radial = true then
                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.edgeSign (L.presSegment s).level
                                        (L.presSegment s).other *
                                      ↑(L.presSegment s).level *
                                    (starRingEnd ℂ) (cf s d) *
                                  (L.presSegment s).moment true (L.pressMode n x) (L.pressureGradMode n x 0)
                                    (L.pressureGradMode n x 2) ↑d
                              else 0

  1 < α →

      Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsFormData α c →
        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellData α c K S B Cl R →
          Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsRowShape c K S R →
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsPressureLayout c K S B L →
              Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsAdmissible c x →
                a ∈ R.rowSet →
                  ∀ (n : ℤ) (i : Fin 3) (cf : Fin L.segCount → Fin (L.degSide + 1) → ℂ),
                    (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                        ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                          ((L.segment s).radial = true →
                              p.1 = (L.segment s).level →
                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p i =
                                  ∑ d, cf s d * ↑((L.segment s).test (↑d) p.2)) ∧
                            (¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                              p.2 = (L.segment s).level →
                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p i =
                                  ∑ d, cf s d * ↑((L.segment s).test (↑d) p.1))) →
                      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
                          (fun p =>

                                (starRingEnd ℂ) (Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p i) +

                                (starRingEnd ℂ)
                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox.radialDeriv

                        ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in K.rect,

                                (starRingEnd ℂ) (Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p i) +
                              L.gradModeOf n x i 0 p *
                                (starRingEnd ℂ)
                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox.radialDeriv
                                    (fun q => ↑q.1 * Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n q i) p) =
                          ∑ s,
                            ∑ d,
                              if (L.segment s).radial = true then
                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.edgeSign (L.segment s).level (L.segment s).other *

                                    (starRingEnd ℂ) (cf s d) *
